place.match: Match each war to where it was fought.
place.reverse: Which of these wars was fought in {value}?

rows.label: Hundred Years' War
rows.description: series of conflicts and wars between England and France between 1337 and 1453
rows.hook: saw English kings fight for the French crown, and included the rise of Joan of Arc

rows.label: Six-Day War
rows.description: 1967 war between Israel and Egypt, Jordan, and Syria
rows.hook: ended in a lightning Israeli victory that put Jerusalem's Old City under Israeli control

rows.label: Second Sino-Japanese War
rows.description: Japanese invasion of China (1937–1945)
rows.hook: saw an island empire invade its giant neighbour and later merge into the global Allies-versus-Axis conflict

rows.label: Wars of the Roses
rows.description: dynastic civil war in England from 1455 to 1487
rows.hook: pitted two rival royal houses, symbolised by a white and a red flower, against each other for the throne

rows.label: Napoleonic Wars
rows.description: 1803–1815 wars involving the French Empire
rows.hook: ended with an emperor's defeat at Waterloo and his exile to a remote island

rows.label: Second Boer War
rows.description: war between two Boer Republics (South African Republic and Orange Free State) and the United Kingdom
rows.hook: pitted the British Empire against Dutch-descended settlers in a gold-rich region

rows.label: Franco-Prussian War
rows.description: 1870–1871 military conflict of the Second French Empire versus Prussia and its allies
rows.hook: ended with Prussia's victory and a new German Empire proclaimed at Versailles

rows.label: Spanish–American War
rows.description: 1898 conflict between Spain and the United States
rows.hook: began after the mysterious sinking of the battleship USS Maine

rows.label: English Civil War
rows.description: series of armed conflicts and political machinations between Parliamentarians and Royalists
rows.hook: saw King Charles I face Oliver Cromwell's Roundheads and ended with the monarch's execution

rows.label: Russo-Japanese War
rows.description: conflict between the Russian and Japanese empires from 1904 to 1905
rows.hook: saw an Asian empire shock the world by defeating a European power at sea and on land

rows.label: French invasion of Russia
rows.description: 1812 conflict during the Napoleonic Wars
rows.hook: left Napoleon's massive army shattered by winter and a long retreat from Moscow

rows.label: Great Northern War
rows.description: conflict between anti-Swedish coalition Led by Russia and Swedish empires in 1700–1721
rows.hook: saw a young tsar topple Sweden's dominance of the Baltic at the Battle of Poltava

rows.label: First Indochina War
rows.description: 1946–1954 French colonial war in Vietnam
rows.hook: ended with a crushing colonial defeat at Dien Bien Phu

rows.label: Greek War of Independence
rows.description: Greek rebellion against the Ottoman Empire (1821–1829)
rows.hook: saw Lord Byron support a rebellion that freed a nation from the sultan's rule

rows.label: Paraguayan War
rows.description: large-scale conflict in South America (1864–1870)
rows.hook: devastated a small landlocked nation and cost it much of its population

rows.label: French Revolutionary Wars
rows.description: 1792–1802 series of conflicts between the French Republic and several European monarchies
rows.hook: saw a young republic fight off royal neighbours and raised a general named Bonaparte to fame

rows.label: Greco-Turkish War
rows.description: war lasting from 1919 to 1922 during the Turkish War of Independence
rows.hook: ended in disaster at the port city of Smyrna and a huge population exchange

rows.label: Japanese invasions of Korea
rows.description: 1592-1598 campaigns against Joseon by Toyotomi Hideyoshi
rows.hook: saw a unifying warlord's armies face Admiral Yi Sun-sin's famous turtle ships

rows.label: Hussite Wars
rows.description: 15th-century wars fought between Protestant Hussites and Catholic forces
rows.hook: featured a one-eyed general and armored wagon forts that stunned charging knights

rows.label: Continuation War
rows.description: 1941–1944 Finnish war against USSR
rows.hook: pitted a small Nordic country against its giant eastern neighbour after the Winter War

rows.label: Gallic War
rows.description: war (58–50 BCE) between the Roman Republic and Gaul
rows.hook: was Julius Caesar's conquest of a wide region, recounted in his own book and ending at Alesia

rows.label: Polish–Soviet War
rows.description: conflict between Poland and Soviet Russia following the First World War (February 1919 - March 1921)
rows.hook: saw the Miracle at the Vistula halt a Red Army advance on Warsaw

rows.label: War of the Sixth Coalition
rows.description: 1813–1814 conflict during the Napoleonic Wars

rows.label: First Barbary War
rows.description: war against Barbary pirates

rows.label: War of the Third Coalition
rows.description: 1805–1806 conflict during the Napoleonic Wars

rows.label: Sino-Soviet border conflict
rows.description: 1969 undeclared conflict between USSR and People's Republic of China

rows.label: South African Border War
rows.description: war on the border of South West Africa/Namibia and Angola

rows.label: Italian Wars
rows.description: Wars in Italy from the 15th to 16th centuries

rows.label: Mahdist War
rows.description: British colonial war

rows.label: War of Attrition
rows.description: 1967–1970 war between Israel and Egypt, Syria and Jordan

rows.label: First Punic War
rows.description: First War between Rome and Carthage

rows.label: Third Punic War
rows.description: war between the Roman Republic and Carthage between 149 and 146 BCE

rows.label: First Boer War
rows.description: military conflict in South Africa (1880–1881)
